title: Rosemary Almond and Pepita Mix with Pear
intro: This fast and simple snack requires just a single skillet. Raw almonds and pumpkin seeds are toasted with savory herbs and served alongside fresh pear for an enjoyable crunch.

ingredients.name: Raw pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

instructions: Combine the almonds, pumpkin seeds, olive oil, rosemary, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl and stir until evenly coated.
Heat a medium dry skillet over medium heat.
Add the nut mixture to the skillet and toast for 4 to 6 minutes. Stir frequently, checking at 4 minutes, until the seeds begin to pop and smell fragrant.
Remove the skillet from the heat and immediately transfer the hot nut mixture to a plate to prevent burning.
Divide the sliced pear between two plates and serve alongside the warm toasted nuts.
variation: Swap the sliced pear for a crisp Granny Smith apple.
conservation: Store leftover cooled nuts up to 3 days at room temperature.

[cooking_method_suitability] Tossing the nuts in garlic powder before toasting them for 4 to 6 minutes in a skillet risks burning the delicate garlic powder, which turns bitter quickly. Concrete fix: Toast the raw almonds and pepitas in the oil first, and toss them with the fresh rosemary, garlic powder, and salt immediately after removing them from the heat while they are still hot.
